cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call a locksmith. Remember where I said we should keep the spare key?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Under the flowerpot. I told you it was a stupid place.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lift the pot, then. You can tell me that again when we're inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's too heavy. And I said the idea was stupid, not you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lift it; you take the key. Once the door's open, try saying my idea was good.
